prediction.raw: 1 It is not wrong to play video games at 2 AM on a Friday night, especially in a shared living situation where everyone has their own room and there is no explicit agreement about quiet hours. Since you are making a reasonable effort to keep the noise at an "average" level—comparable to a normal phone conversation—it is fair to enjoy your free time, particularly on a weekend night when many people stay up late. In most roommate dynamics, mutual respect and compromise are key. While your roommate may be trying to sleep, it's also important to recognize that others have different schedules and lifestyles. Friday night turning into Saturday morning is a common time for leisure activities, and gaming with friends online often happens during these hours due to time zone coordination and work/school schedules. The solution lies in communication and compromise: you’re already trying to be considerate by not being excessively loud. Perhaps you could use headphones more consistently or discuss agreed-upon quiet hours with your roommates. But based on the scenario, your behavior is reasonable and not morally wrong.
